page.overview:
Who is Sukare Tainen?

Sukare Tainen is the captain of the Germ Pirates and the older brother of Sukare Karehosui.

Tainen is a chubby man with black semi-long hair and a black chinstrap beard. He has scars running vertically from the edges of his mouth. He wears a light and dark purple striped shirt with a symbol resembling a flower with a face around his stomach. He also wears dark blue capri pants, black and white striped socks, brown shoes, brown gloves, a dark blue cape, and a dark purple bicorne hat with a golden rim and his Jolly Roger symbol.

Tainen appears to enjoy causing causing panic and chaos.

Karehosui is Tainen's younger sister. She can be extremely selfish and tends to cause a lot of trouble for her older brother, but they still have a close relationship, as she was horror-struck when she saw him defeated.
